diff-upstream.//: Print the complete unified diff of Quartz Core against its pinned upstream commit: every vendored change, generated from the tree, never hand-maintained. Steering files, pruned files and Core's pnpm files are not drift and never appear (utils/core-tiers.mjs). stdout is a patch (`git apply`-able from the repo root); the file count goes to stderr. Save with: pnpm nx run site-v5:diff-upstream > vendored.patch

vendored-log.//: List every commit that has changed Quartz Core (quartz-v5/core) since the last sync, with the drift it made and the tickets it cites, and flag any that cite none. Commits that only moved Core, or changed only its steering, pruned or pnpm files, are left out. Uncommitted drift is listed too. Informational: the tracker for ADR-0001's one-ticket-per-vendored-change rule.

diff-latest.//: Informational: what an upgrade to the tip of the tracked branch would pull in, leaving out steering, pruned and pnpm files.

sync.//: Re-vendor at a new upstream ref, keeping the steering files and Core's pnpm files and deleting the pruned ones. Refuses while Core carries vendored changes, since syncing replaces the tree: save them with diff-upstream first, then run upstream.mjs sync <ref> --force and re-apply. Usage: nx run site-v5:sync --args="--ref=<commit|branch>"

install.//: Install Quartz Core's dependencies, frozen, from its lock: exactly the versions upstream's package-lock.json pins at the pinned ref (core-lock checks it). Core is a pnpm 11 project of its own (core/pnpm-workspace.yaml), outside the repo's workspace, so this runs pnpm 11 by exact version through npx whatever pnpm the repo root pins.

core-lock.//: The lock check: Core's pnpm lock holds exactly the packages of the pinned ref's package-lock.json, each at the same version, with nothing on either side the other lacks. Fetches that one file from upstream; compare a local npm lock instead with --args="--npm-lock <file>". Exits 1 on any difference.

test-utils.//: The node --test suites of this project's tooling (utils/test/): the lock check, run against small synthetic locks.

plugin-dag.//: Rewrite the dependency DAG on the plugins' tag page, the Mermaid block between the generated markers in content/public/tags/projects/site/plugins/index.md, from every package's manifest: engine edges from `quartz.dependencies`, library edges from the libraries a package builds with (#86). tests/specs/plugin-dag.spec.mjs fails while the note has drifted. Check without writing: node quartz-v5/utils/plugin-dag.mjs --check

prebuild.//: Prepare Quartz Core to build the real site: refuse to go on without the site config, core/quartz.config.yaml (a steering file; upstream's default is pruned, so there is nothing to fall back on), link host node_modules beside local plugins, and build every local plugin the site config enables. See VENDORED.md.

build.//: Build the real site: content/public, with the site config, into quartz-v5/core/public, then finish it with utils/postbuild.mjs: the site's own root-level files (robots.txt, BingSiteAuth.xml, the IndexNow key file) and the site's icon over stock's (static/icon.png, favicon.ico). Extra flags go to `quartz build`, e.g. --concurrency=4.

serve.//: Build the real site and serve it with Quartz's dev server, rebuilding on content changes. Mixed-case redirects are only emitted on a case-sensitive filesystem, so a macOS serve shows none. The output, quartz-v5/.serve-public, is outside Core on purpose: serve's source watcher watches every .ts and .tsx under it, and would take the vault's widget sources, which the build copies into its output, for Quartz's own and restart the whole build over and over (cgc-mdx's watch spec).

_serve-static.//: Helper: serve the real site's build, quartz-v5/core/public, on port 8080 for the Lighthouse targets. Ported from v4's `site` project (FORK-LEDGER, #42: keep).

eval.//: Lighthouse audit of the built site's home page, served by _serve-static, then its actionable insights (utils/lighthouse).

eval:live.//: Lighthouse audit of the live site, then its actionable insights (utils/lighthouse).

eval:multi.//: Lighthouse CI over the first public pages of the built site's sitemap, served by _serve-static, then the aggregated insights. generate-urls-from-sitemap.mjs writes the lighthouserc.cjs autorun reads.

clean.//: Remove build output and caches from Quartz Core.
